anchor.semantic_hook: Letting one's guard down becomes a protective guard shield that visibly drops the instant attention slips.
anchor.setting: A multipurpose vigilance hall contains a goal bay, a shop counter, a cafe table, an office desk, an oven station, and a chess table. One gigantic guard shield hangs from a loose ceiling hinge and drops across whichever activity occupies the central floor. All other fixtures are ordinary and undecorated.

variations.scene_adjust: one final plain product box and several empty shelf spaces fill the shop bay

variations.scene_adjust: a phone, a cup, and an otherwise bare cafe table stand in the central activity area

variations.scene_adjust: an office chair, a desk, closed project folders, and a small tray of finished work occupy the office bay

variations.scene_adjust: a chessboard with evenly matched pieces sits on the central table

One building-sized unnumbered clock face spans the ceiling, carrying two separate sets of hands that travel at different speeds. The hall's ordinary activity bays sit directly beneath their shared circular path.
